title: Night IR camera-trap training subset (LILA BC)
description: Format only in this build: no image is pinned yet. Night infrared frames from LILA BC camera traps (raccoon, opossum, skunk, dog, cat, vehicle boxes, plus empty frames as hard negatives), disjoint from the nir-night benchmark set. Each entry is a benchmark-manifest image (file, url, sha256, size, width, height, tags, objects with label + bbox [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in pixels); the training run maps the labels onto its class list. See docs/TRAINING.md.
